lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters organized in several horizontal rows; the most prominent row is situated posterior to the fifth branchial slit and runs parallel to the primary dorsal ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature on the upper flank characterized by a high-contrast luminance gradient, exhibiting specular highlights on the dorsal side and deep shadowing on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct vertical branchial slits with low-luminance interior pixels, located anterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
